verdict.rationale: OpenCode's enterprise docs say its centralized config can integrate with an organization's SSO provider for authentication and route all users through an internal AI gateway. That covers the core of authenticating through enterprise identity for compliance. Evidence is limited to two brief doc statements. Missing for 10: detail on which SSO protocols or identity providers are supported (SAML/OIDC, Okta, Entra), explicit cloud-platform authentication (e.g., Bedrock/Vertex IAM), setup depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
